svg.text: OPEN CHANNEL OFFENSIVE / MAP STUDY 02 / PROPOSED
Interior sites / seven exterior starts · 32 × 28 m building
TWO PLANT SITES · EVERY WALL DESTRUCTIBLE + REINFORCEABLE
A / B = alternative plant pockets · ATK 1–7 = attacker zones
All pale walls, including exterior + courtyard walls, can be destroyed or reinforced.
Gaps = existing doors · dashed purple = one intact A↔B rotation · grid = 1 m
Gray blocks = cover (breakable in Lightwell). No permanent wall chokepoints.
Draft geometry only — balance, sightlines and sound require in-engine playtests.
